paired_stop.interval: 90% paired moving20-session blocks; zero dates included
paired_stop.stop_gain_attribution: Matched entry net changes plus added/missing entries; stop-trade PnL alone is not causal stop gain

side.conditioning: Raw proposals and their same-calendar active dates conditioned on observed price signals; no future occupancy or filled-count conditioning
side.execution: Full replay.run for each null; unchanged fixed stop, band/VWAP check exits, reversal, flatten and final costs
side.data_hole_policy: All null outcomes retained; no gap day excluded or filled. Closed-ledger p-values remain descriptive when observed/null held paths contain unknown prices or censored positions.
side.comparison_scope: Joint direction, reversal, occupancy, turnover and execution-cost policy comparison.
side.interpretation: Random opposite proposals create additional reversals and much higher filled trade counts; the result does not isolate direction prediction at matched turnover or costs.

time.conditioning: Raw proposals and their same-calendar active dates conditioned on observed price signals; no future occupancy or filled-count conditioning
time.execution: Full replay.run for each null; unchanged fixed stop, band/VWAP check exits, reversal, flatten and final costs
time.data_hole_policy: All null outcomes retained; no gap day excluded or filled. Closed-ledger p-values remain descriptive when observed/null held paths contain unknown prices or censored positions.
time.future_information: The same-date permutation can move directions from later raw signals to earlier checks, using a proposal count and direction mixture only known later that date.
time.comparison_scope: Future-informed retrospective comparator; not a causal random-entry strategy.
time.interpretation: Its p-values cannot establish that causal entry timing fails or that the strategy has zero edge.

cash_data_presence_definition: Every predetermined normal date has at least one observed valid OHLCV minute from selected anchor through15:00. This does not assert full minute or scheduled-decision coverage and does not clear the account gate.
